scope.oos: Verified-witness detection under declared search budgets, not a proof that unresolved cases are infeasible. Cost tails are conditional on each method finding a verified plan.
scope.region: Grid approximation on seven fixed full-trajectory charts, not global coverage of the full nonlinear process feasible set.
scope.ac: AC power flow convergence and operating-limit compliance are reported separately.
scope.scaling: Same finite candidate sets and NCCG stopping tolerances, median of three single-thread runs; initialization and final inner check included. The separately solved full MILP independently verifies each identical-instance objective.
